subject.title: [Bug]: Webchat UI: session dropdown label shows wrong agent (displays a different agent than the one actually running/selected)

question: Which open pull request should be the canonical fix for session-to-agent synchronization: broaden and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/112852, or rebase and land the already broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111893?
rationale: Both pull requests address the same reported symptom, but their scope differs materially and both are currently dirty; selecting an owner boundary is a maintainer judgment rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Adopt the broader synchronization fix
options.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111893 as the canonical path because it explicitly covers sidebar, active-pane, alias, and global-scope synchronization with supplied real behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow to sidebar selection
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/112852 only if maintainers confirm that the issue is limited to sidebar navigation and the broader paths intentionally retain their present behavior.

options.title: Replace both with a focused maintainer patch
options.body: Close neither until a new narrow patch establishes one shared synchronization owner and carries the relevant regression scenarios.

recommendation.title: Adopt the broader synchronization fix
recommendation.body: Rebase and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111893 as the canonical path because it explicitly covers sidebar, active-pane, alias, and global-scope synchronization with supplied real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete, who also linked the broader candidate into the discussion.
